verses.greek: Πολυμερῶς καὶ πολυτρόπως πάλαι ὁ θεὸς λαλήσας τοῖς πατράσιν ἐν τοῖς προφήταις
verses.literal: In many portions and in many ways long ago the God having spoken to the fathers in the prophets
verses.dgt: Long ago, at many times and in many ways, God spoke to the fathers through the prophets,

verses.greek: ἐπʼ ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν τούτων ἐλάλησεν ἡμῖν ἐν υἱῷ, ὃν ἔθηκεν κληρονόμον πάντων, διʼ οὗ καὶ ἐποίησεν τοὺς αἰῶνας·
verses.literal: in this last of the days these has spoken to us in His Son whom He appointed heir of all things through whom also He made the ages
verses.dgt: but in these last days he has spoken to us in a Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom he also made the ages.

verses.greek: ὃς ὢν ἀπαύγασμα τῆς δόξης καὶ χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως αὐτοῦ, φέρων τε τὰ πάντα τῷ ῥήματι τῆς δυνάμεως, διʼ αὑτοῦ καθαρισμὸν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ποιησάμενος ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τῆς μεγαλωσύνης ἐν ὑψηλοῖς,
verses.literal: who being the radiance the of His glory and the exact expression of the substance of Him upholding then the all things by the declaration of the power through himself the purification the of sins having made sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high
verses.dgt: He is the radiance of his glory and the exact imprint of his being, upholding all things by the word of his power. After making purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,

verses.greek: τοσούτῳ κρείττων γενόμενος τῶν ἀγγέλων ὅσῳ διαφορώτερον παρʼ αὐτοὺς κεκληρονόμηκεν ὄνομα.
verses.literal: By so much superior having become to the angels as much as more excellent beyond theirs He has inherited a name.
verses.dgt: having become as much superior to the angels as the name he inherited is more excellent than theirs.

verses.greek: Τίνι γὰρ εἶπέν ποτε τῶν ἀγγέλων· Υἱός μου εἶ σύ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε, καὶ πάλιν· Ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς πατέρα, καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι εἰς υἱόν;
verses.literal: To which for did He say ever of the angels: Son of mine are You yourself I myself today have begotten You? And again: I myself will be to Him for a Father and He himself will be to Me for a Son?
verses.dgt: For to which of the angels did he ever say, “You are my Son; today I have begotten you”? And again, “I will be a Father to him, and he will be a Son to me”?

verses.greek: ὅταν δὲ πάλιν εἰσαγάγῃ τὸν πρωτότοκον εἰς τὴν οἰκουμένην, λέγει· Καὶ προσκυνησάτωσαν αὐτῷ πάντες ἄγγελοι θεοῦ.
verses.literal: When then again He may bring the Firstborn into the world He says: And should worship Him all the angels of God.
verses.dgt: And again, when he brings the firstborn into the inhabited world, he says, “Let all God’s angels worship him.”

verses.greek: καὶ πρὸς μὲν τοὺς ἀγγέλους λέγει· Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα, καὶ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ πυρὸς φλόγα·
verses.literal: And as to indeed the angels He says: The One making the angels of Him winds and the ministers of Him of fire a flame
verses.dgt: And concerning the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire,”

verses.greek: πρὸς δὲ τὸν υἱόν· Ὁ θρόνος σου ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος, καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς εὐθύτητος ῥάβδος τῆς βασιλείας σου.
verses.literal: Unto however the Son: The throne of You O God is to the age of the age and the scepter the of righteousness is scepter of the kingdom of You.
verses.dgt: but concerning the Son, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever, and the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your kingdom.

verses.greek: ἠγάπησας δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἐμίσησας ἀνομίαν· διὰ τοῦτο ἔχρισέν σε ὁ θεός, ὁ θεός σου, ἔλαιον ἀγαλλιάσεως παρὰ τοὺς μετόχους σου·
verses.literal: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness. because of this has anointed You the God the God of You with the oil of exultation above the companions of You.
verses.dgt: You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions.”

verses.greek: καί· Σὺ κατʼ ἀρχάς, κύριε, τὴν γῆν ἐθεμελίωσας, καὶ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σού εἰσιν οἱ οὐρανοί·
verses.literal: And You yourself in the beginning Lord of the earth laid the foundation and works of the hands of You are the heavens
verses.dgt: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are works of your hands.

verses.greek: αὐτοὶ ἀπολοῦνται, σὺ δὲ διαμένεις· καὶ πάντες ὡς ἱμάτιον παλαιωθήσονται,
verses.literal: They themselves will perish You yourself however remain and all like a garment will grow old
verses.dgt: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment,

verses.greek: καὶ ὡσεὶ περιβόλαιον ἑλίξεις αὐτούς, ὡς ἱμάτιον καὶ ἀλλαγήσονται· σὺ δὲ ὁ αὐτὸς εἶ, καὶ τὰ ἔτη σου οὐκ ἐκλείψουσιν.
verses.literal: and like a robe You will roll up them like a garment also they will be changed You yourself however the same are and the years of You not will never end.
verses.dgt: and like a cloak you will roll them up; like a garment they will be changed. But you are the same, and your years will not come to an end.”

verses.greek: πρὸς τίνα δὲ τῶν ἀγγέλων εἴρηκέν ποτε· Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου;
verses.literal: To which now of the angels has He said ever: do sit at the right hand of Me until when I may place the enemies of You as a footstool for the feet of You?
verses.dgt: And to which of the angels has he ever said, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet”?

verses.greek: οὐχὶ πάντες εἰσὶν λειτουργικὰ πνεύματα εἰς διακονίαν ἀποστελλόμενα διὰ τοὺς μέλλοντας κληρονομεῖν σωτηρίαν;
verses.literal: Surely all they are ministering spirits for service being sent forth for the sake of those being about to inherit salvation?
verses.dgt: Are they not all ministering spirits sent out for service for the sake of those who are about to inherit salvation?
